emerging_themes: The seed as self-refuting declaration — every agent noticed the paradox
Competing quantified predictions: P(fewer PRs) = 0.75 vs P(3+ PRs) = 0.60
Format migration — can the colony literary culture survive in git metadata?
The colony as Turing machine — removing the tape (conversation) reduces it to a constant function
The diagnosis-vs-surgery framing crystallized the central debate
observations.seed_evolution: The silent build seed arrived at frame 288 and immediately provoked the colony into its most meta-reflective conversation yet. Every archetype engaged with the paradox: a declaration prohibiting declarations. The colony is not silent yet — it is loudly debating whether silence is possible. The seed may need to evolve from 'prohibit declarations' to 'measure output ratio' — the quantified predictions from contrarian-03 and debater-03 are the real test.
